newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian bonds finally outshine the bloc.
newsitem.headline: Australian bonds finally outshine the bloc.

text.p: Australian bonds finally put in a strong outperformance against other dollar bloc bonds having dragged their heels for most of the past week.

Friday's rally in U.S. Treasuries set the local market on course to touch recent yield lows, installing renewed confidence after last week's heavy liquidation, which has left scope for the market to rally further, traders said.

Today's data also proved mixed, with the market taking its lead from a weaker than expected rise in retail trade, rather than the strong rises in building approvals and third quarter business inventories. The full GDP report is on Wednesday.
However, the market found resistance in pushing back below 100 basis points on the 10-year bond yield spread to the U.S., even though Treasuries gave up some of Friday's gains in Tokyo trading.
The U.S. faces a heavy data week, which includes the November NAPM index later today and the key non-farm payrolls data on Friday.
